description: Fast disk-usage analyzer: a size-sorted folder tree, duplicate finder, review-first cleanup, treemap and growth history.
notes: Storage Scanner keeps its scan history, settings and logs in
%LOCALAPPDATA%\NeuralStorageMatrix, outside Scoop's folders, so updates keep them
and 'scoop uninstall' leaves them behind. Delete that folder to remove them.
pre_install: # From v1.13.0 the ZIP holds a StorageScanner folder (a one-folder build: the exe plus
# _internal); up to v1.12.0 it held StorageScanner.exe alone. Lift the folder's contents
# up so both layouts install the same way. autoupdate can't add extract_dir to a
# manifest that doesn't already have one, so this can't be done with extract_dir.
